auth.loginDescription: Sign in to your HomeInventory account.
auth.registerDescription: Set up HomeInventory to start tracking your household.
auth.taglineBody: The calm, shared home inventory for the things that matter.
auth.featureTrackBody: Catalog items room by room, box by box — and find them in seconds.
auth.featureSharedBody: Everyone stays in sync with a single, always-current inventory.
auth.featurePrivateBody: Your home data stays yours, secured behind your account.

kitchen.description: Use what expires first. Tracks every lot with an expiration date.

movements.title: History
